business_summary: Live Ventures Incorporated, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the flooring and steel manufacturing, and retail businesses in the United States. It operates in five segments: Retail-Entertainment, Retail-Flooring, Flooring Manufacturing, Steel Manufacturing, and Corporate and Other. The Retail-Entertainment segment provides a selection of entertainment products, including new and pre-owned movies, video games, and music products, as well as ancillary products, such as books, comics, toys, and collectibles. This segment also offers services to customers, such as rentals, special orders, disc, video game hardware repair, and other services. The Retail-Flooring segment retails and installs flooring, carpeting, and countertops to consumers, builders, and contractors. The Steel Manufacturing segment manufactures pre-finished de-carb free tool and die steel comprising deluxe alloy plate, deluxe tool steel plate, precision ground flat stock, and drill rod; industrial knives and hardened wear products for the tissue, metals, and wood industries, as well as for in-house grinding, machining, and heat-treating; manufactures and supplies engineered parts and components to various industries, such as appliance, automotive, hardware, electrical, electronic, medical products, and devices; and offers specialized fabricated metal products, including cable racks, auxiliary framing, hardware, insulation products, and network bays. It serves steel distributors and steel service centers. The Flooring Manufacturing segment manufactures and distributes carpets and rugs, yarn, and hard-surface flooring products focusing on the residential, niche commercial, and hospitality end-markets. This segment serves flooring dealers, home centers, other flooring manufacturers, and directly to commercial end-users. The Corporate and Other segment provides product and service for new customers. Live Ventures Incorporated was incorporated in 1968 and is based in Las Vegas, Nevada.
business_summary_ko: Live Ventures Incorporated는 자회사와 함께 미국에서 바닥재, 철강 제조, 소매 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 소매 엔터테인먼트, 소매 바닥재, 바닥재 제조, 철강 제조, 기업 및 기타 등 5개 부문으로 운영됩니다. 소매-엔터테인먼트 부문은 신규 및 중고 영화, 비디오 게임, 음악 제품뿐만 아니라 책, 만화, 장난감, 수집품과 같은 보조 제품을 포함한 다양한 엔터테인먼트 제품을 제공합니다. 이 부문은 또한 임대, 특별 주문, 디스크, 비디오 게임 하드웨어 수리 및 기타 서비스와 같은 서비스를 고객에게 제공합니다. 소매 바닥재 부문은 소비자, 건축업자 및 계약자에게 바닥재, 카펫 및 조리대를 소매하고 설치합니다. 철강 제조 부문은 고급 합금판, 고급 공구 강판, 정밀 연삭 플랫 스톡 및 드릴 로드로 구성된 사전 완성된 무탄화물 공구 및 다이강을 제조합니다. 조직, 금속, 목재 산업뿐만 아니라 내부 연삭, 기계 가공 및 열처리를 위한 산업용 칼 및 경화 마모 제품; 엔지니어링 부품 및 부품을 제조하여 다양한 산업에 공급하고 있습니다.
